# Debt Free Empire

> Debt Free Empire makes private, no-subscription personal finance apps and tools for people paying off debt and building financial stability. Founded by Robert Daniels in Southern California.

## Products

### Paper & Prosperity (Free App)
- Budget planner, debt payoff tracker with debt-free date simulator, savings vaults, bill calendar
- Completely free — no subscription, no ads, no bank connection required
- Available: iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Web
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/paper-prosperity/id6809006042
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.paperandprosperity.paper_and_prosperity
- Web: https://app.paperandprosperity.shop
- Product page: https://www.debtfreeempire.com/paper-and-prosperity

### Empire Life Dashboard ($37 one-time, after a 7-day free trial)
- Desktop life planner: budgeting, debt payoff, habit tracker, savings goals, daily planner
- One-time purchase — no subscription, no bank connection required
- Free to download with a 7-day free trial on both platforms, then a one-time $37 unlock ($36.99 on Windows)
- Available: Mac and Windows. iPhone and iPad: coming soon
- Mac App Store ($37): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/empire-life-dashboard/id6816514942?mt=12
- Microsoft Store ($36.99): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NFTF14DSH6S
- Product page: https://www.debtfreeempire.com/apps/empire-life-dashboard

### Spreadsheets & Printables ($3–$12 one-time)
- Budget spreadsheets, debt trackers, savings planners — works in Excel and Google Sheets
- Etsy shop: https://www.etsy.com/shop/PaperandProsperity

## Who it's for
- People who feel behind on money, are paying off credit cards or other consumer debt, and want a calm, judgment-free plan
- People who don't want to connect a bank account or pay a monthly subscription
- Not a fit for people who want automatic bank syncing (YNAB or Monarch Money may suit them better)

## How it compares to popular budgeting apps
- YNAB (about $109/year, bank sync): Paper & Prosperity is a free, no-bank-connection alternative
- EveryDollar (free tier plus paid upgrade): Paper & Prosperity is free with no paid tier needed
- Monarch Money (about $99/year): Paper & Prosperity and Empire Life Dashboard have no subscription
